escena: SCENE (a whole studio seen as a tiny planet, Santiago, afternoon, NO recognisable faces): a LITTLE PLANET stereographic projection of a full 360-degree panorama — verify it by these landmarks: the floor of the studio curves into a COMPLETE SPHERE at the centre of the frame, so the whole room wraps around a round ground that reads like a small planet; the walls and equipment radiate OUTWARD from that sphere like spokes, leaning away in every direction; the ceiling becomes the SKY filling all four corners of the square frame; and the horizon is a CLOSED CIRCLE with no beginning or end. Hard afternoon sun pours through the skylights above, so the sky in the corners is bright and the curved floor carries strong directional shadows. Around the curved floor, a small crew works on a set, their bodies tilting outward from the centre, caught at the instant one of them walks across the curve of the little planet carrying a light stand. This is a real stereographic projection of a spherical panorama, not a fisheye rectangle and not a vignette. Shot as a 360 panorama and reprojected. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.
